body_markdown:
AmpliTech Group is heading to the 11th[Annual Florida International Trade and Cultural Expo (FITCE)](https://www.broward.org/econdev/conferences/fitce) , South Florida’s premier international trade event, November 18-19. FITCE brings together buyers and sellers from more than 70 countries for two days of business insights, networking and cultural exchange.


We’re looking forward to connecting with partners and new contacts from around the world. Come find us if you’re attending!


[Or, send us a note today to schedule a meeting with us.](https://www.amplitechgroup.com/contact-us/)
